notes: Locate phase. Plain static site: app.js and styles.css are each a single minified line, so locations are line 1 plus a 1-based column found by exact text search (indexOf) in the file; HTML files have real line numbers. Colour tokens are generated at runtime in app.js (function he, light map from col ~1180, dark map from col ~600) and written to --c-* custom properties; type, spacing, radius and duration tokens are in styles.css :root. No component library. No data-insp-path attributes. No builder notes or other evaluators' output were read.
